_about: Certificate Authorities that major browser root programs have distrusted. Matched against the certificate issuer organisation (O). 'issued_after' means only certificates issued after that date are affected. Add entries only from authoritative sources (Chrome Root Program, Mozilla CA/Incident reports, Apple). Owner: P1.

authorities.name: DigiNotar
authorities.reason: CA compromise; fraudulent certificates issued for Google and others (2011)

authorities.name: Symantec legacy PKI (Symantec, VeriSign, GeoTrust, Thawte, RapidSSL)
authorities.reason: Repeated mis-issuance; distrusted by Chrome 70 and Firefox (2018). Brands now issued by DigiCert under new roots are not affected.

authorities.name: Camerfirma
authorities.reason: Long-running compliance failures; distrusted by Chrome and Mozilla (2021)

authorities.name: TrustCor
authorities.reason: Concerns about ties to surveillance-related entities; removed by Mozilla, Chrome and Apple (2022-2023)

authorities.name: E-Tugra

authorities.reason: Security incident exposing internal systems; removed by Mozilla (2023)
